content: function ExportSecuredKey [SWS_CRYPT_20728] Upstream: RS_CRYPTO_02105 , RS_CRYPTO_02112 virtual ara::core::Result < std::size_t > ExportSecuredKey (AlgId alg Id, CryptoObject:: Sptr key, ReadWriteMemRegion resultBuffer, ara::core::Optional < SymmetricKey :: Sptr > kek) noexcept=0; The interface shall format the data referenced by the specified key, securely wrap this payload and serialize the secured payload into the provided output buffer. The format shall be specified implicitly by the AlgId. The formatted payload shall be wrapped according to the specified algId using the kek; if kek is not provided, ExportSecuredKey shall apply a key-encryption-key implictly defined by the algId or the default key-encryption-key of the CryptoProvider.
